newsitem.title: USA: Topeka, Kan., finance officers resigning posts.
newsitem.headline: Topeka, Kan., finance officers resigning posts.

text.p: Topeka's assistant chief administrative officer and city controller have submitted their resignations effective July 11, an assistant to Mayor Joan Wagnon said Tuesday.
Terry Dody, assistant chief administrative officer-director of financial services submitted his resignation to Wagnon Thursday, Donna Freel said.
Dody has been selected as assistant city manager for Branson, Mo., Freel said.
Controller Deanna Schlegel submitted her resignation Friday to join a new section of Kansas state government studying the possibility of privatizing some services, Freel said.
